results.title: GitHub - gcarreno/setup-lazarus: Set up your GitHub Actions workflow with a specific version of Lazarus · GitHub
results.snippet: When building with the Qt5 widgetset, using the combination of stable or v3.0 with ubuntu-latest or ubuntu-22.04 may fail. This issue is due to an outdated libqt5pas library that doesn't support Lazarus 3.0 updates.

results.snippet: For many players new to EMU servers, things here are not exactly the same as LIVE servers. Please, take your time to read over this Wiki and understand that even the BEST players on Lazarus started the same as you and even after a couple years....we're still learning new things.

results.snippet: Lazarus has a huge community of people supporting each other. It include scientists and students, pupils and teachers, professionals and hobbyists. Our wiki provides tutorials, documentation and ideas.
